Pulliam’s Pizza to Open Tomorrow in Downtown Palmetto

  • The City Menus
  • November 10, 2026

Photo: Pulliams Instagram

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:31
Instaread

A new pizza restaurant is officially opening its doors in downtown Palmetto this week, bringing a new place to enjoy pizza and gather with family and friends.

Pulliam’s Pizza will celebrate its grand opening tomorrow, Wednesday, November 11, at 5 p.m., at 546 Main Street in Palmetto, Georgia.

Heavy construction began this past summer, and residents have watched the downtown property undergo a major transformation over the past several months. From new flooring and doors to colorful artwork and an updated outdoor patio, the restaurant has been steadily taking shape.

Throughout the process, Pulliam’s has shared construction updates on Instagram, giving future customers a behind-the-scenes look at the progress. One of the more unique features is a yellow brick road that helps guide visitors to the restaurant.

Now, after months of hard work, the team is ready to welcome the community.

“It’s taken a long time for us to build this restaurant, now it’s your turn to fill it with good vibes, friends, families, and fun!” the restaurant shared in its opening announcement on Instagram.

Pulliam’s will initially be open Wednesday through Sunday from 5 to 10 p.m., serving dinner only. The restaurant plans to add lunch service at a later date.

Visitors can park near the downtown water tower and follow the yellow brick road to the restaurant.

The opening of Pulliam’s Pizza marks an exciting addition to downtown Palmetto, offering a new destination for dining and bringing people together in the heart of the city.
